claims.author: ajtowns
claims.harm: removing expiry entirely prevents node operators and miners from reverting to previous default behavior if the change turns out harmful
claims.quote: I don't think it's a good idea to change the node's behaviour in a way that doesn't allow users/miners to revert to the previous default in case the change turns out to be undesirable or harmful for s

status_by.quote: I think the reasons mentioned above by you and @ajtowns are thin. ... So it would be more ideal to just clean this code up and remove this feature

claims.status_note: author replied arguing that reasons to keep expiry are thin, adversarial cycling makes it ineffective, and expiry creates privacy leaks on rebroadcast

claims.author: ajtowns
claims.quote: Is there any reason why this change shouldn't be phased in via setting `DEFAULT_MEMPOOL_EXPIRY_HOURS` to a large value, such as 35040 (4 years), instead?
claims.request: phase in the change by setting DEFAULT_MEMPOOL_EXPIRY_HOURS to a large value (e.g. 4 years) rather than removing it entirely

status_by.quote: There is a legitimate concern raised by @mzumsande, and offline by a few other people, that this approach also aids censorship, so I won't be comfortable shipping it.

claims.status_note: author declined phasing in via DEFAULT_MEMPOOL_EXPIRY_HOURS citing censorship concerns

claims.quote: would it be fine to use 6 in MallocUsage() so that the same -maxmempool budget can hold extra txn you talked about in the nice side-effect?
claims.status_note: author confirmed MallocUsage() has been updated in the latest push

claims.harm: wallet_resendwallettransactions.py no longer verifies that a parent transaction is resubmitted before its child
claims.quote: wallet_resendwallettransactions.py no longer checks that a parent is resubmitted before its child.

claims.author: fametrano
claims.quote: Could this PR use 6 pointers, as tumutech suggests, or drop the "fits slightly more transactions" sentence?
claims.request: update DynamicMemoryUsage() to use 6 pointers per entry or drop the claim from the PR description
claims.status_note: fixed in push confirmed in rc:4455310210 updating MallocUsage() to use 6 pointers

claims.author: fametrano
claims.quote: One change may deserve a line in the note: `abandontransaction` on a wallet transaction older than two weeks now fails with "Transaction not eligible for abandonment".
claims.request: document in the release notes that abandontransaction now fails for transactions older than two weeks

claims.author: musaHaruna
claims.harm: Removing expiry entirely could cause outdated nodes to retain high-feerate transactions rejected by miners, displacing minable transactions under memory pressure and raising the minimum mempool feerate.
claims.quote: Under memory pressure, they could displace lower-feerate transactions that miners would actually include, potentially causing more `SIZELIMIT` removals and raising the minimum mempool feerate.

status_by.quote: The best thing to do in this case is to update the node, because expiry doesn't help here either.

claims.status_note: author replied that expiry does not prevent rebroadcast cycles, fee estimator defaults are not affected, and outdated nodes should update

claims.author: musaHaruna
claims.quote: I'm leaning toward deprecating `-mempoolexpiry` rather than removing its functionality immediately, with age expiry disabled by default but still available explicitly during the deprecation period.
claims.request: Deprecate `-mempoolexpiry` with age expiry disabled by default rather than removing its functionality immediately.

status_by.quote: So it would be more ideal to just clean this code up and remove this feature, it is unnecessary.

claims.status_note: author declined deprecation, arguing immediate removal is cleaner and avoids incentives for free relay

claims.author: musaHaruna
claims.question: Whether there is existing evidence that the protection expiry provides against persistent policy disagreement is negligible enough to justify removing the mechanism entirely.
claims.quote: Is there already evidence that the protection expiry provides against persistent policy disagreement is negligible enough to justify removing the mechanism entirely, rather than just changing the defa

status_by.quote: I think the fact that it is possible, and that we see such transactions mined, should suffice.

claims.status_note: author replied that observing such transactions being mined demonstrates incentive compatibility
